name: Li Jian Rong
source:
The elderly driver for Yun's illegal call girl service.

Being a warm and sincere man who’s well-liked by the ladies he chauffeurs belies the fact that he was once the boss of Yun and a legendary Chinese gang who exercised power over Kabukicho. 

[From Shiravune, via [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1433]MangaGamer[/url]]
